scope: Independent M3 bivariate season-forward OOS, not M9 production or Crown
method: Compare previous season's mean team expected-points forecast residual against next season's observed forecast residual, only teams present both seasons. Also compare previous TWO seasons' pooled residual to next-season residual. Compute weighted covariance slope and sign agreement, and per-league/year Pearson correlation. This directly probes persistence rather than performance of corrected probabilities.
caveats: Previous/current season model predictions are OOS per source, but league-season OOS archive may use date-only timestamps.
Per-team Pearson correlation is across teams, not independent match evidence; sample sizes limited.
Current-season residual is evaluated retrospectively, never used to generate the earlier forecast.
A stable correction to 1X2 can arise from shrinkage or calibration even without persistent team residual sign.
No M9 score-grid, Crown price or formal trading ROI.
